correctness.rationale: All k>=3 and ell>=2 are covered by exhaustive six-type cross-path conflict analysis. That analysis bounds strong clique sizes by k+1 and supplies matching cliques; length two is a complete conflict graph. At length four, a hypothesized (k+1)-coloring forces distinct missing colors and a same-branch distance-two collision. Explicit constructions cover length two, three, four, five and all >=6 with a valid three-periodic middle and boundary avoidance. Standalone code verified 464 constructions, exact chromatic numbers on 30 small instances, and clique sizes on 50, as corroboration only.

value.rationale: This exact infinite two-parameter classification identifies a uniform series-parallel family with χ(L(G)^2)>ω(L(G)^2) precisely at one arm length, by exactly one color. It also proves an unbounded drop 2k to k+1 under a natural subdivision and sharp stabilization for all larger lengths; these are structural rather than isolated computational facts.
